name: Hamsters of Speed
summary:
With a hamster ball as your vehicle of choice, compete against other players in various mini-games! Use your real-life movements to steer the hamster ball, and master the technique so you can win first place!

Quick join to play with other random hamsters, or host a lobby and play with up to 3 other friends!
